notes: The image shows the breadboard with rows f-j in the top half. In the catalogue's naming the f-j half is bank 'b', so the circuit uses bank 'b' holes.
Column positions were read from the image: orange wire in column 3 (row g), resistor from column 3 to column 6 (row h), LED legs in columns 6 and 8 (row i), black wire in column 8 (row h).

The text says the long leg (anode) connects to the resistor output and the short leg (cathode) connects to ground. In the image the bent, longer leg is in column 6 with the resistor, so that leg is A.
The GND header pin next to pin 13 is used for the Arduino end of the black wire, named GND.1.
The USB cable to the computer is not drawn in the circuit, so it is not included. Processing and Max/MSP are software only.
